meaning:
κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon.
(κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;]
to curse: with accusative, Mrk.11:21; opposite to εὐλογέω, Luk.6:26, Rom.12:14, Jas.3:9; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): Mat.25:41.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
